..purpose: `createAuth` and `defineAuthPolicy`, the `Auth` it returns and the types its signature needs; the `PlainRequest` and `PlainResponse` transport types, the `AuthStore` port and its record types, `Clock`, `RandomSource`, `DeploymentMode`, the `TransportError` and `ConfigError` classes, and the OCSF security event types.

./express.environment: Node, Express 5 (typed structurally; no dependency on express)
./express.purpose: `expressAuth(auth, { public })`: mounts test-cap on an Express app, serves `/auth/*` from the raw request stream, and protects every other route at the default requirement unless it is listed as public.

./fetch.environment: Web Request and Response globals; its tests run on Node, and Bun and Deno are planned for phase 6
./fetch.purpose: `withAuth(auth, handler, { public, clientAddress })`: wraps an app's fetch handler, serves `/auth/*` and protects every other route at the default requirement unless it is listed as public; `fetchAuth(auth)` serves the `/auth/*` routes alone and answers `null` for any other path.

./next.environment: Next.js 16 App Router on the Node.js runtime (typed structurally; no dependency on next)
./next.purpose: `nextAuthHandler(auth)` for `app/auth/[...path]/route.ts`; `nextServerAuth(auth, { headers })`, the authoritative check for route handlers, server functions and the data-access layer; `nextProxy(auth, { public })`, an optional proxy for early redirects that is not protection.

./tanstack-start.environment: Web Request and Response, TanStack Start 1.169 (typed structurally; no dependency on TanStack Start)
./tanstack-start.purpose: `tanstackStartMiddleware(auth, { public })`, the server function of a global request middleware that protects every route and server function call at the default requirement unless its path is listed as public, and puts the subject in `context.auth`; `tanstackStartAuth(auth)`, whose `handlers` serve the `/auth/$` server route and whose `require` and `session` let a server function check a requirement itself.

./store/memory.environment: isomorphic, no dependencies; development and test only
./store/memory.purpose: `memoryStore()`: the reference `AuthStore`, kept in one process's memory. It declares itself not durable, so production and staging refuse to start with it.

dependencies.@maverickcer/env-cap: Optional peer. Only `src/env.schema.ts` imports it, so env-cap can document and validate test-cap's variables in an app that uses env-cap; without it, `createAuth` takes plain values (ADR 0022).
dependencies.hash-wasm: Runtime. argon2id password hashing in WebAssembly, with no native build (ADR 0018). It was chosen because it is the only argon2id found that runs on Node, Bun and Deno (ADR 0023); CI hashes on Node only so far. MIT, no dependencies of its own.
